passages: [prose] Mobility category was assigned by summing scores from suction trap data and expert survey. One point was assigned if species were in the top 25% of species caught in Rothamsted Insect Survey (RIS) suction traps (mean yearly catch over period 2000–2009). Expert opinion was the mean value of responses where five experts were asked to assign species to categories of low (0), medium (1), and high (2) mobility (see Table 2). “Score” sums these two methods of classification and mobility category was assigned according to thresholds: $\leq 1 = \mathsf { L O W } ,$ >1 to ≤2 = Medium and >2 = High. Species mean values for the tethered flight variables “Total distance flown overnight” and “maximum speed” are also shown.
